sources.snippet: Official Hub for MiniMax H3 (minimaxh3.run) — An all-in-one open-source resource platform for MiniMax H3 (Hailuo AI 3.0), the state-of-the-art native multi-modal 2K AI video generation model with synchronized 3D stereo audio.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: H3-AudioVAE compresses 32 kHz audio into latent tokens at a 40 Hz temporal rate, running the left and right channels independently through a shared encoder and decoder and recombining them for stereo. Model Variants MiniMax H3 ships as two task-specific checkpoints: H3-Base-FL2VA handles first-and-last-frame mode.
